title: The First Layer of the Secret Realm · Illusory Maze
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought the illusory trial had ended, a faint guiding light suddenly illuminated, pointing directly toward a direction deep within the secret realm that resonated mysteriously with the Tianji Record — what on earth lay hidden there?

text.content: The moment the void warped, Chen Ji felt darkness swallow his vision, as if an invisible giant hand had seized him. When the dizziness faded, he found himself standing in a vast expanse of white mist. The surroundings were eerily silent, even his own breathing seemed devoured by the fog. The Tianji Record — he instinctively wanted to invoke its fractured prophetic power, only to find the threads of fate blurred beyond recognition, as if obscured by something. This was the first time he had felt such pure dread of the unknown, beyond what the Tianji Record could reveal.

dialogue.content: Hmph! What trash of an illusion, daring to trap this one?!

text.content: A familiar voice echoed from the depths of the white mist — it was Han Lie, the number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect. The young man, radiating fierce battle intent, swung his fists at the void, each strike stirring violent gusts that scattered the surrounding fog. Unfortunately — the mist dispersed only to reconverge, reconverged only to disperse again, seemingly without end. Chen Ji hid in the shadows, lips twitching involuntarily. This idiot's brain truly hadn't grown at all.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Get your wretched self out here! Was this your doing?!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the fog, wearing an expression of utter terror, his body trembling slightly — a perfect picture of a spineless wretch scared out of his wits by the illusion. Inwardly, he coldly smirked — with your level of intelligence, you dare match wits with me? The self-cultivation of a drama king, Chen Ji had mastered it perfectly. Surface废物, actual demon lord — this was the correct way for a transmigrator to be.

dialogue.content: Han… Han Shixiong, spare me! I don't know what's happening either! I'm truly just a废物!

text.content: Han Lie coldly snorted, about to strike, when he noticed other figures hidden within the white mist. A cold female voice rang out: "Enough." Su Qingyao, dressed in white, slowly walked out from the fog, her gaze cold and sharp as it swept across both men. Her eyes lingered on Chen Ji for a moment — in that instant, Chen Ji felt an almost piercing scrutiny that seemed to see through his disguise. But she said nothing more, merely remarking flatly: "The illusory trial has already begun. Rather than fighting amongst ourselves, we should first find a way out."

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's proposal, how should Chen Ji react?

choices.text: Continue feigning weakness, follow Su Qingyao
choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona, use Su Qingyao's presence as cover, secretly observe the illusion's weaknesses
choices.visible_cost: May need to cooperate with Su Qingyao's actions
choices.visible_reward: Gain an opportunity for close observation of the illusion
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's scrutiny made Chen Ji somewhat uncomfortable

text.content: Chen Ji hastily bowed and scraped,一副唯 Su Qingyao 马首是瞻的样子："Su Shijie说得是！我就跟着您，您让我往东我绝不往西！" Inwardly, he rapidly calculated: Su Qingyao's observational skills were indeed sharp; he needed to find a way to divert her attention.

choices.text: Deliberately point in the wrong direction to test teammates
choices.description: Pretend to be unable to discern the illusion's patterns, let Su Qingyao and Han Lie lead the way, secretly observe their true reactions
choices.visible_cost: May provoke greater displeasure from Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Test out the teammates' true capabilities
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao sees through the trick, it may raise suspicion

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he pointed in a completely opposite direction: "That way! I feel there's an exit that way!" Su Qingyao frowned slightly, while Han Lie directly scoffed. But Chen Ji noticed that when he pointed in the wrong direction, a trace of imperceptible recognition flashed in Su Qingyao's eyes — she had seen through it, simply choosing not to expose him.

choices.text: Reveal some strength to intimidate Han Lie
choices.description: Slightly show some edge, let Han Lie know he's not to be trifled with, while leaving a deep impression on Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie will temporarily hold back
choices.risk_hint: Displaying strength may draw unnecessary attention

text.content: Chen Ji calmly raised his hand, a sharp gust of energy slicing through, precisely cutting through the fog's core — that was the structural weak point of the illusion. The mist instantly dissipated in a large area. Han Lie's pupils slightly contracted, and Su Qingyao's gaze congealed. This move seemed simple, but it required extremely high discernment and deep understanding of illusions — definitely not something a废物 could do.

The three continued forward, and within the white fog, some half-visible phantoms gradually appeared. Sometimes ethereal pavilions and towers, sometimes blurred human figures moving about, sometimes诡异 low whispers. Han Lie had already started烦躁地四处乱撞, while Su Qingyao remained vigilant throughout, and Chen Ji — he was carefully observing the patterns of these phantoms. Soon, he discovered the weakness.

These phantoms appeared randomly arranged, but they all followed a common rule — they became clearer when an "observer" looked directly at them, and gradually dissipated when the "observer" deliberately ignored them. In other words, this wasn't an illusion meant to confuse the mind, but a maze testing "concentration" and "judgment." Chen Ji's eyes lit up. Interesting — such a trial was child's play for him.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, what did you discover?

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao seemed to have noticed Chen Ji's abnormality. How should he respond?

choices.description: Since Su Qingyao was already suspicious, might as well openly display his observational skills — after all, elaborate explanations that dig the hole deeper are even more suspicious
choices.visible_reward: Accelerate the speed of breaking the illusion
choices.risk_hint: Exposing strength may attract more people's attention

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Su Shijie, these phantoms follow one rule — the more attention, the clearer they become; the more ignored, the more they fade. What we need to do is selectively ignore those trap phantoms while focusing on the true exit." Su Qingyao slightly raised an eyebrow, her gaze toward Chen Ji growing more complex.

choices.text: Deliberately give wrong information, let Su Qingyao discover it herself
choices.description: Give a plausible yet false answer, observe how Su Qingyao reacts — neither exposing oneself nor testing her abilities
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao doesn't react in time, she may really take the wrong path

text.content: Chen Ji pretended to ponder deeply: "This嘛… I always feel we should look up? No, look down? Aiyo, I don't know either, Su Shijie you decide!" Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even tighter, but eventually she nodded and began verifying Chen Ji's unreliable guess. As a result, she actually discovered the clue from it — Chen Ji was guiding her, not genuinely clueless.

choices.text: Ask Su Qingyao for her opinion in return
choices.description: Throw the question back, observe Su Qingyao's reaction, gain more intelligence from it
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become even more vigilant

text.content: Chen Ji tilted his head: "Su Shijie, you're the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, you've seen much more of the world — what do you think?" Su Qingyao deeply gazed at him, then suddenly smiled — this was the first time Chen Ji saw her smile, yet it sent an inexplicable chill down his spine. "Chen Ji, you're far more interesting than I imagined." Her tone was profound, "Very well, let me share my thoughts."

Just then, the fog ahead suddenly thickened, and a massive phantom materialized — it was a stone gate dozens of zhang high, covered in densely packed runes that emitted a faint glow. From within the door's seams, something seemed to stir restlessly. Han Lie's eyes lit up: "There's an exit!" As he spoke, he charged forward.

dialogue.content: Han Shixiong, wait! That's a trap!

text.content: Unfortunately Chen Ji called out too late — or rather, he deliberately called out slowly. Han Lie had already slapped his palm against the stone gate. In an instant, the runes erupted with dazzling light, a terrifying force surged from within the gate, sending Han Lie flying backward. He crashed heavily to the ground, spitting a mouthful of blood. "Idiot." Chen Ji silently gave Han Lie's intelligence a zero in his heart, then continued feigning terror as he hid behind Su Qingyao.

dialogue.content: Cough… you… how did you know that was a trap?!

choice.prompt: Facing Han Lie's questioning, how should he respond?

choices.description: Pretend he only coincidentally called out correctly, continue maintaining the废物 persona
choices.visible_cost: Han Lie may not believe it
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao has already seen through the truth

text.content: Chen Ji wore an innocent face: "I… I don't know either! I just felt that gate was wrong, maybe my innate intuition is quite accurate?" Han Lie eyed him suspiciously, clearly not fully convinced. But Chen Ji's utterly pathetic appearance really didn't seem acted, reducing his suspicion by a几分.

choices.description: While Han Lie is suffering,狠狠嘴毒一番, let readers feel satisfied
choices.visible_reward: Verbal attacks feel good for a moment
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may hold a grudge and seek revenge

text.content: Chen Ji sighed, using a tone of "how can you be so stupid": "Han Shixiong, although I'm a废物, at least I know — the more something looks like an exit, the more likely it's a trap. You, the number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect, wouldn't possibly be ignorant of this common sense?" Han Lie's face turned green with rage, yet he couldn't refute — after all, he truly did crash into it himself.

choices.text: Seize the opportunity to exchange conditions with Su Qingyao
choices.description: Use this opportunity to express cooperation intentions to Su Qingyao, pave the way for future team formation
choices.visible_cost: Need to reveal some trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Establish cooperative relationship with Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may use this opportunity to probe

text.content: Chen Ji ignored Han Lie, turning to Su Qingyao and lowering his voice: "Su Shijie, my intuition tells me this secret realm is no simple place. Rather than fighting separately, we should temporarily cooperate." Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then finally nodded. "Alright. But I have one condition — when we get out, you must tell me who you truly are." Chen Ji smiled: "Deal."

After the stone gate trap was triggered, the illusion changed. The dense white mist began gradually dispersing, replaced by a winding cobblestone path. At the path's end, an ancient altar faintly came into view. Just then, a faint light suddenly shone from the altar's direction, penetrating the layers of mist, pointing directly at Chen Ji — the Tianji Record Fragment was faintly glowing and heating up.

Chen Ji's heart tightened. The altar's direction… the ruins resonating with the Tianji Record? Within there, what lay hidden? Were there other fragments of the Tianji Record, or something even more dangerous? He suppressed the excitement in his heart, his face still maintaining that unruffled expression. But his footsteps had unconsciously quickened.

Chen Ji's footsteps paused. He turned to look at Su Qingyao, offering an innocent smile: "Nothing much, just feeling like something over there is calling to me. Su Shijie, would you like to come together?" Su Qingyao deeply gazed at him, asked no further questions, simply nodded. The three — primarily Chen Ji and Su Qingyao — stepped onto that cobblestone road leading to the altar. And behind them, Han Lie, clutching his chest, a flicker of malicious resentment in his eyes, had no other choice but to follow.

On both sides of the cobblestone path, mist still lingered but had lightened considerably. Occasionally, some broken stone statues could be seen scattered along the roadside — some with blurred faces, others wearing诡异的 smiles. Chen Ji noticed that the gazes of all these stone statues were directed toward the altar — as if silently watching every passerby. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng once said: "The inheritor of the Tianji Record is never the only one." Could these stone statues be… the other "inheritors" throughout history?

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind) Lad, your perception is correct. Beneath that altar, indeed part of the Tianji Record is sealed. However — there are also things sealed there that should never be awakened. Proceed with caution.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly stopped, as if it had never existed. Chen Ji frowned but did not show it. Things that should never be awakened? The truth of the Tianji Record indeed wasn't that simple. But the faintly heating Fragment told him that regardless of what dangers lay ahead, he had to see for himself. Fate had already pushed him to this crossroads.

Passing through the final stretch of cobblestone path, the three finally arrived before the altar. This altar was even more magnificent up close than it appeared from a distance. The blue stone foundation was carved with runes similar to those on the Tianji Record Fragment, and at its center stood a translucent crystal pillar, within which something seemed sealed. And the light causing resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment was precisely emanating from this crystal pillar. Just as Chen Ji stepped forward to investigate, the entire altar suddenly trembled, and an ancient, majestic voice reverberated through space: "You who have passed the first trial… speak your desire."

The first layer of the illusory trial reached its final choice at this moment. And that mysterious light pointing toward the altar awaited Chen Ji — awaited the inheritor of the Tianji Record — to uncover its true secret.
